en.headline: Pianist John Lee to play City Hall in Hong Kong Artists series
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said tickets at HK$220 are on sale for the 8pm recital on 27 October at the City Hall Theatre.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will present a piano recital by John Lee, known in Chinese as Lee Tsz-long, at 8pm on 27 October at the Theatre of Hong Kong City Hall, as part of its Hong Kong Artists Series 2026.

The department said the first half will include Rachmaninov transcriptions of violin works, among them Bach's Suite from Violin Partita No. 3 in E, and Rachmaninov's Variations on a Theme of Corelli, Op. 42. The second half will include Granados works inspired by paintings and cantabile pieces such as Liszt's setting of Schubert's "Der Müller und der Bach" and a Tchaikovsky children's song arranged by Volodos.

Lee graduated from the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts and later studied at the Royal College of Music in London. The department said he has won first prizes at the CLAMO Music International Piano Competition in Murcia, the Watford International Piano Competition and the Liszt Memorial Prize Hong Kong-International Piano Open. Tickets priced at HK$220 are available through URBTIX, with telephone bookings on 3166 1288. The same series also lists a saxophone recital on 8 October and a dizi recital on 9 November.

zh.headline: 康文署香港藝術家系列十月呈獻李子朗鋼琴演奏會
zh.dek: 李子朗10月27日晚上8時於大會堂劇院演出，票價220元，現已於城市售票網發售。
body: 康樂及文化事務署「香港藝術家」系列2026將於10月27日晚上8時在香港大會堂劇院舉行李子朗鋼琴演奏會。
康文署表示，上半場將演繹拉赫曼尼諾夫改編的小提琴曲目，包括巴赫《E大調第三號小提琴組曲》，以及拉赫曼尼諾夫《柯雷里主題變奏曲，作品四十二》。下半場包括格拉納多斯《戈雅之畫》等以畫作為靈感的作品，以及李斯特改編舒伯特《磨工與小溪》、柴可夫斯基兒童歌曲等歌唱性曲目。
李子朗畢業於香港演藝學院，其後赴英國皇家音樂學院深造，曾獲西班牙穆爾西亞卡利莫國際鋼琴大賽、屈福特國際鋼琴比賽及「李斯特紀念獎」香港-國際鋼琴公開賽冠軍。票價220元，現於城市售票網發售，電話購票3166 1288。同系列另有10月8日吳漢紳色士風演奏會及11月9日笛子演奏會。
